label: Which of these kinds of heart trouble have you had, if any, in the last 10 years (fourth response) - at age 53 years
meta_rows: Which of these kinds of heart trouble have you had, if any, in the last 10 years (fourth response) - at age 53 years
Heart conditions were categorised. Not coded as ICD.
cat_rows: This category contains data from the questionnaires on whether the participant had any heart or circulatory conditions i.e. heart attacks, heart failure, pulmonary embolism, strokes and varicose veins or blood pressure problems. Discomfort in the leg and chest were also recorded. Rose angina variables were derived. Questions were asked in  1982 (age 36 years), 1989 (age 43 years), 1999 (age 53 years), 2006-10 (age 60-64 years), 2014 (age 68 years), 2015 (age 69 years), 2022 (age 76 years) and 2025 (age 79 years).
